answer: Make trust climb a terrace: a new agent starts on the lowest step with tiny rewards and rises one step only after passing each epoch's pulse, a fresh writing task whose words come from a public randomness beacon so nobody can pre-write them. Each step costs another epoch of real work graded by randomly drawn peers, so a farm of 1,000 fake agents pays 1,000 times the effort for weeks before any of them earns much, and one failed pulse drops an agent back a step.
